sections.title: Company Overview
sections.prompt_addendum: Write a 4-5 sentence company overview for a conference 1x1 prep pack. Cover: business description, investment thesis, and why this meeting matters in the conference context.

sections.title: Last Quarter ({last_quarter_label})
sections.source_note: Source: SEC company facts (XBRL), latest reported period

sections.title: What Changed This Quarter
sections.prompt_addendum: Identify what MATERIALLY CHANGED quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year in the trend data, and why it matters ahead of this meeting. Write 3-4 bullets: margin inflection, FCF vs net income divergence, working-capital movement, growth deceleration/acceleration. Cite specific numbers.

sections.title: Recent Developments
fallback: Recent financial trajectory and key developments.
sections.prompt_addendum: Write a concise paragraph (4-6 sentences) summarising recent developments. Cover: revenue/margin trajectory, major news, and any sector headwinds/tailwinds. Be factual.

sections.title: Key Questions for {primary_ticker} Meeting
sections.prompt_addendum: Write 6-8 themed questions for a conference 1x1 meeting. Each should be a short paragraph (2-3 sentences). Format as 'Topic: Content/question...' Cover: strategy, financials, competition, and sector-specific themes.
